d: Long, wavy ash-blonde hair falls past the shoulders, partially concealed by a dark teal military cap. The pale grey eyes have a vacant, solemn expression, set within a mature face with visible stitch-like scars across the bridge of the nose and cheeks. A slender build is dressed in a full-length black gown featuring a high neckline and a vertical seam held together by silver safety pins, layered with a dark teal military cape adorned with gold epaulettes and white tassels. Accessories include a pink sash draped across the torso and a weathered brown leather book held in the right hand.
